cleavage_agent.evidence: Further processed of the flow-through portion of the depletion included automated protein isolation, denaturation, tryptic digestion, and peptide isolation.

enrichment_method.evidence: Individual human serum samples were partitioned and depleted of 14 specific highly abundant proteins using a ProteomeLab™ 12.7 × 79.0-mm human IgY14 LC10 affinity LC column (Beckman Coulter, Fullerton, CA), which was performed using the manufacturer’s instructions to disrupt protein-protein binding and capture of additional proteins.

fractionation_method.evidence: Briefly, three pooled human serum samples were created (baseline, 8 weeks negative culture status, 8 weeks positive culture status) and divided into 24 fractions each using HPLC high pH fractionation.

instrument.evidence: LC-MS/MS was performed on each fraction using the LTQ Orbitrap Velos MS and a reverse phase low pH LC separation.
